title: Travel: John Lennon – London to Nice | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from London to Nice in France on 14 May 1971.

They were accompanied by their assistant Dan Richter, and stayed at the Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc in Antibes near Cannes on the French Riviera.

The purpose of the trip was the screening of their films Fly and Apotheosis at La Quinzaine des Réalisateurs, an independent showcase running alongside the Cannes Film Festival. They also attended the festival itself during their stay in the south of France.
